heroSummary: Peoria Unified students begin the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026, and the last day of school is Thursday, May 20, 2027. The calendar lists 179 student days, and schools dismiss two hours early on modified Wednesdays. Thanksgiving break runs from November 23–27, and spring break is March 15–19. Students are also off on Friday, December 18 for a teacher workday before winter break begins.
calendarNotes: Peoria Unified separates modified Wednesdays from other grade-band early-release dates. Families should also watch for elementary conference dates, high school early-release dates, furlough/no-school dates, teacher workdays, and rotation-calendar resources.

sourceReviewSummary: Dates and schedule details on this page were checked against Peoria Unified’s 2026–27 calendar PDF, school-year calendars page, calendar update, and published rotation-calendar resources.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified the first day, last day, holidays, furlough/no-school dates, teacher workdays, modified Wednesdays, breaks, elementary conference dates, high school early-release dates, and instructional-day totals against the district PDF.

Peoria uses more than one early-release pattern: modified Wednesdays use a two-hour early-dismissal schedule, while other early-release dates are marked separately for high schools, elementary schools, or both.
The district also publishes 5-day and 6-day rotation calendars for 2026–27; families should use those resources when a campus or program follows a rotation schedule.
The district’s 2026–27 calendar update explained that the move to an August 3 start was paired with shorter breaks during the fall.
alternateCalendarsDescription: Peoria Unified publishes separate rotation calendars for schools that use 5-day or 6-day schedules. The 6-day calendar applies only to select elementary schools. Use the rotation calendar assigned by your school, and check the district calendar page for revisions.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Peoria Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Peoria Unified starts the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a modified Wednesday on the PUSD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: On a modified Wednesday, Peoria Unified schools dismiss two hours earlier than usual. Not every Wednesday uses the modified schedule, so check the date list and your school’s bell schedule.

Students do not attend school on Friday, December 18 because it is a teacher workday. Peoria Unified’s winter break runs from Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Peoria Unified schools use a rotation calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Only schools assigned a rotation schedule should use one. Peoria Unified says its 6-day calendar applies to select elementary schools.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Peoria Unified revisions.

customSections.label: What Changed for 2026–27
customSections.content: Compared with 2025–26, the first day of school moved from Thursday, July 31, 2025, to Monday, August 3, 2026. Peoria Unified described the later start as a trade-off for shorter breaks during the fall. The Governing Board approved the calendar in November 2025, and this page reflects the PDF ratified on March 26, 2026.

customSections.label: How Peoria Unified’s Calendar Works
customSections.content: Peoria Unified’s calendar uses several labels for early dismissal and days when students do not attend. Schools dismiss two hours early on modified Wednesdays, but not every Wednesday follows that schedule. Some other early-release dates apply only to high schools, elementary schools, or both. Families should check their school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.

rows: All schools dismiss two hours early.
Not every Wednesday is modified; use the date list and your school’s bell schedule.
The district marks October 8–9 for elementary conferences. Check your school’s schedule for conference times and dismissal changes.

High schools release early on November 4, December 16–17, and May 19–20. Elementary schools release early on December 17, February 11, and May 20. Check your school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.
Students do not attend on teacher workdays, including December 18 before winter break.
Teachers report July 28–30, and district schools and worksites are closed for a furlough day on July 31.
